verdicts.reason: A: The orange divider rule runs through the body copy ('kitchen and released'), which is a real collision. The body copy is pushed off the headline's centre axis, the 'Ships late June' note sits awkwardly beside the button, and the huge dark left panel holds only a tiny logo, so it is mostly dead space. B: The dark header is cut off into a strange top-left block. The divider rule is stranded on its own at the far right, the body copy and legal line are tiny and hard to read, and the headline, body and CTA are scattered with no shared grid, leaving the right side empty. A still reads as a split banner and is the less broken of the two.
